iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="BPMN Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Measure" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Measure_Merge" name="Measurement cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_OK_Loop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restart_Loop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Collect_Data" name="Collect machine data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Calculate_OEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Check" name="OEE below threshold?"
                           default="Flow_OEE_OK">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_OK</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Stop_Machine" name="Stop machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Email" name="Send email to engineer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Machine_Restarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restart_Loop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_Restarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <!-- Continue measuring: OEE at or above threshold returns to the measurement cycle -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Merge" sourceRef="StartEvent_Measure" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge" targetRef="Task_Collect_Data"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_Collect_Data" targetRef="Task_Calculate_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Check" sourceRef="Task_Calculate_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_OK" name="OEE at or above threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge_OK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below" name="OEE below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Task_Stop_Machine">
      <!-- Threshold value is not specified in the description; the variable is a placeholder -->
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oee < oeeThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Email" sourceRef="Task_Stop_Machine" targetRef="Task_Send_Email"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Wait" sourceRef="Task_Send_Email" targetRef="Event_Machine_Restarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_Loop" sourceRef="Event_Machine_Restarted" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>

    <!-- Helper merge for the OEE-OK path, kept as a separate exclusive merge to loop back -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Measure_Merge_OK" name="Continue measuring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_OK</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_OK_Loop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_OK_Loop" sourceRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge_OK" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>

    <!-- Disconnection handling: event subprocess stops the process -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_Disconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process_Stopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_End</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TerminateDef_Stopped"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_End" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_Process_Stopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
